reviewMode: Refute, do not confirm. Every cited digest recomputed from live bytes. Every live-state claim rechecked against live file 08, live COORD, live git, and the frozen artifacts themselves, not carried forward from turn 1. The two turn-1 findings were re-derived from the frozen turn-1 review and tested against the turn-2 bytes rather than accepted on the draft's 'Lands' assertion. The turn 1 to turn 2 delta was diffed in full to hunt for defects introduced by the repair.
independence: The other reviewer's D-250 output was not read, in either turn. docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-250.review-adversarial.codex.json and docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-250.turn2.review-adversarial.codex.json were both observed to exist by directory listing only; their bytes were never opened, and the turn-2 verdict is unknown and not inferred. The turn-1 Codex verdict CONSENT 0/0 is taken only from the dispatch, which supplies it as a given. Stage A reviews are independent reviews of the leftover-join artifact rather than peer reviews of this subject, and were read as measured inputs. The frozen turn-1 Claude 2 review was read: it is this reviewer's own prior turn, and reading it is required to judge whether CLAUDE-D250-SF1 and CLAUDE-D250-SF2 landed.
decision: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Both turn-1 SHOULD-FIX findings are landed in full and to the letter of their stated remedies, not paraphrased and not partially applied. All twenty-three dispatched attacks are REFUTED. Every one of the fifteen cited digests recomputes to the cited value from live bytes, including the two occupancy artifacts that the draft names by role rather than by path. Every live-state recital is independently true against live file 08, live COORD and live git. The turn 1 to turn 2 delta introduces no new defect: it is confined to the two repairs, the Stage B turn-1 custody record that a turn-2 draft is required to carry, and one unforced improvement that answers a turn-1 observation.
